comment: A256GCM-S64K media vectors (contract v1.11, crypto review R6). Generated by `cargo test -p risime-mls media_vectors -- --ignored`. All binary fields are lowercase hex. A negative case must fail with `expect` when opened with alg A256GCM-S64K and its key, plain_size, cipher_size and sha256.
hkdf: HKDF-SHA256, salt empty, info = hkdf_info, L = 32

negative.name: truncated_last_segment
negative.why: two_segments with its last segment dropped (truncation at a boundary); plain_size 65536 makes the sizes consistent, so only the final flag catches it

negative.name: segment_from_other_blob
negative.why: segment 0 of two_segments followed by segment 0 of one_full_segment (another key); plain_size 131072 makes the sizes consistent

negative.name: final_flag_on_non_final
negative.why: plain_size 67000; segment 0 encrypted with the final flag set

negative.name: last_segment_16_bytes
negative.why: a full segment followed by a 16-byte last segment (no plaintext byte)

negative.name: tag_bit_flipped
negative.why: len_100 with one bit of its tag flipped (sha256 is of the flipped blob)

negative.name: nonzero_padding
negative.why: plain_size 9 padded to 10 with a 0x80 pad byte, correctly encrypted

nonce: 0x00 x 7 || uint32_be(i) || (0x01 if last segment else 0x00)
